description: This file contains the implementation of the Cart class within the OpenCart system, responsible for handling shopping cart operations such as adding products, calculating totals, applying discounts and specials, managing options, and interacting with the database.

classes.name: Cart
classes.description: Class responsible for managing shopping cart operations such as adding products, retrieving cart data, and processing options within the OpenCart framework.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the cart with dependencies from the registry and cleans up expired cart entries.

methods.name: getProducts
methods.description: Retrieves the list of products in the cart, with all associated options, discounts, and pricing calculations.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds a product to the cart, handling quantity, options, subscription plans, overrides, and pricing.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates the quantity of a specific cart item, then refreshes the cart data.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes a product from the cart by cart ID and resets cart data.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Clears the entire cart and resets cart data.

methods.name: getSubscriptions
methods.description: Returns an array of subscriptions associated with the products in the cart.

methods.name: getWeight
methods.description: Calculates total weight of products in the cart, considering weight class conversions.

methods.name: getSubTotal
methods.description: Calculates total price before taxes, discounts, and other adjustments.

methods.name: getTaxes
methods.description: Calculates applicable taxes for each product based on tax class and rates, returning aggregated tax data.

methods.name: getTotal
methods.description: Calculates the total price including taxes for all products in the cart.

methods.name: countProducts
methods.description: Counts total quantity of all products in the cart.

methods.name: hasProducts
methods.description: Checks if the cart contains any products.

methods.name: hasSubscription
methods.description: Checks if the cart contains any subscription products.

methods.name: hasStock
methods.description: Determines if all products in the cart are sufficiently stocked.

methods.name: has
methods.description: Checks if a specific cart item exists by cart ID.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Deletes a specific cart item by its cart ID.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Removes all items from the cart and resets data.

methods.name: getSubscriptions
methods.description: Returns an array of subscription details for products in the cart.

methods.name: getWeight
methods.description: Calculates total weight of all products, factoring in individual weight and weight class conversion.

methods.name: getSubTotal
methods.description: Calculates subtotal price of all products before taxes and other adjustments.

methods.name: getTaxes
methods.description: Gathers and sums applicable tax amounts based on product tax classes.

methods.name: getTotal
methods.description: Computes total order amount including taxes.

methods.name: countProducts
methods.description: Returns the total quantity of all products in the cart.

methods.name: hasProducts
methods.description: Returns true if the cart contains any products.

methods.name: hasSubscription
methods.description: Returns true if the cart contains any subscription products.

methods.name: hasStock
methods.description: Returns true if all products are in stock.

methods.name: hasShipping
methods.description: Checks if any product in the cart requires shipping.

methods.name: hasDownload
methods.description: Checks if any product in the cart is downloadable.
